description: How far a procedure's leg with no fix of its own to end at is drawn, nm (ARINC 424-18 5.21): an FC leg its coded distance from its fix; a leg flown to an altitude (FA, CA, VA) from the altitude known at its start at 200 ft a nm (FAA Order 8260.3), within 1 to 15; any other (to a DME distance, a radial, an intercept, a manual termination) 2 nm.
